a: forgeTest registers a story file's tests again inside every test file that imports it
repoOf takes any git host for GitHub, so a GitLab or Bitbucket origin reports a `repo` and a misleading reason
componentOf drops everything past the second segment of a dotted component name
fileDates misses files whose paths git still quotes with core.quotepath=off
bindingsOf treats a top-level `let` as reassigned when an inner scope assigns its own variable of the same name
b: apiTable leaves the files of the type definitions it prints out of `sources`, so they go stale
The component's own file, read for destructured defaults, is not recorded in `sources`
destructuredDefaults finds no defaults for a component wrapped by reference (`memo(ChipImpl)`)
Bindings.componentOf keeps only two segments of a dotted `component`
parseFile turns on JSX only for `.jsx`/`.tsx`, so a `.js` or `.mjs` story containing JSX fails to index
fileDates misses paths that git C-quotes, so those components get no history
passThrough sends the original request headers on to a redirect's new origin
